This version follows the Krig Norwegian rules tested against Norske kortspill. Two to four players share a standard 52 deck of cards without jokers. Cards are dealt face down as high as possible; with three players, one card is placed aside unseen. Everyone turns the top card together. The highest rank wins all cards on the table; suits are irrelevant. The ace is the highest and 2 is the lowest. If the highest card is tied, each player joining the battle places one card face down and then one card face up. The card with the new highest face takes the whole pile. If again tied, the same move is repeated. A player who cannot provide both battle cards loses; their remaining cards join the battle pile. The last player with the card wins. This game is driven by luck, may take a long time, and this version does not claim to prevent every possible replay sequence.
